bibl.title: The Abandonment of Myos Hormos.
bibl.seg: Dario Nappo, The Abandonment of Myos Hormos.

Paolo Cimadomo, Rocco Palermo, Raffaella Pappalardo & Raffaella Pierobon Benoit (edd.), Before / After. Transformation, Change, and Abandonment in the Roman and Late Antique Mediterranean (Oxford, 2020) pp. 19-34, figg.
bibl.note: Introduction. - The so-called third century crisis. - Debasement of the currency. - Inflation. - Destruction of Coptos. - Suggests a connection with the opening of Trajan's canal after 112 CE and the consequent rise of Clysma.
